request: Use only LinearRouter for the hono/quick preset and remove SmartRouter and TrieRouter from it, so the bundle stays small.

source.request: Use only LinearRouter for the hono/quick preset and remove SmartRouter and TrieRouter from it, so the bundle stays small.
source.settled: The hono/quick preset uses SmartRouter with LinearRouter and TrieRouter to support route patterns LinearRouter cannot handle.
source.why: Removing the router combination would lose the route-pattern coverage the preset gained.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
